approvers: Main contractor or developer via subcontract package; my managing director
reason: Our aluminium arrives with factory film and what we add costs about €12 a m² with our own people, and we only spend around €1,244 a year on it. €19 a m² is well above that, and the main contractor decides who pays for protection anyway.
objection: A coating on coated glass and finished frames is a risk to my frames and my relationships, and the €2,500 cap would not cover a full-unit replacement. There is no Maltese reference job, and I would be paying more than my current film for it.
instead: Keep the factory film plus our own film or board and tape, applied and removed by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor writing protection into the subcontract package as a paid line, plus written coating-maker compatibility approval for my glass coatings and frame finishes and a Maltese reference job at or below about €12 a m².
